meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 推进计划执行,并行调度多个子代理完成工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你制定好计划后希望一键执行并分派给子代理
copy.tagline_en: Execute your plan and orchestrate parallel subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed plan and want to execute it with subagents.

howto.what: 安装后,当你说“开始工作”时,Claude 会变成总指挥:它从 .omo/plans/ 里挑选工作计划,把任务拆成小块,派给多个子代理并行干活,自己只负责检查结果、记录进度,并更新计划清单。
howto.when: 当你说“start work”“execute plan”“continue plan”等词,或要求继续/运行 .omo/plans 计划时触发。

say.text: 开始执行 .omo/plans 里的当前计划
say.note: Claude 会读取计划并开始编排子代理。

say.text: 继续执行计划,从下一个未完成的复选框开始
say.note: 它会接着上次进度继续推进。

say.text: 以 PR 模式启动计划,完成后开一个拉取请求
say.note: 会创建工作分支并提交 PR。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you say "start work", Claude becomes an orchestrator: it picks a plan from .omo/plans/, splits tasks into small units, dispatches them to parallel subagents, and only checks results, records progress, and updates the plan checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "start work", "execute plan", "continue plan", or ask to resume/run an .omo/plans plan.

say_en.text: Start executing the current plan in .omo/plans
say_en.note: Claude reads the plan and begins orchestrating subagents.

say_en.text: Continue the plan from the next unchecked checkbox
say_en.note: It resumes from where it left off.

say_en.text: Launch the plan in PR mode and open a pull request when done
say_en.note: Creates a work branch and submits a PR.
